payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The original mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
outcome.reference: Identify the mug and headphones in the source image and compare their left-to-right positions in the edited image. The source shows the blue mug to the left of the black headphones.

check.question: Is the mug positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
check.complete_when: The mug is clearly to the right of the headphones.
check.partial_when: The mug has visibly moved toward the right of the headphones compared with the source, but is not clearly to their right.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the mug has not moved toward the right of the headphones, or that it remains to their left without progress toward the requested position.
check.unknown_when: The relative positions or any progress cannot be determined confidently.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image clearly shows a mug on the right and black headphones near the center, so both objects and their left-to-right positions are assessable.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows the mug clearly to the right of the headphones; the source had the blue mug to their left."}
